crossRefs.note: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants…
Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will…
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink…
Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with…
praising God, and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being…
He brought them up into his house, and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly, with all his household, having…
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…
For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right…
In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display…
Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for…
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed…

translations.web: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
translations.bsb: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
translations.kjv: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
translations.asv: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
